inv_home_c_mum.text: Thomas Telford built the Caledonian Canal, finished in 1822, so boats could cross the Highlands without sailing round the top.
Go and watch the locks at Muirtown. The boats go up like they are climbing a staircase made of water.

then.text: I have given you a cup already. Do not be greedy, the kettle is tired.

else.text: There, a cup of tea to go. You look like someone who has been watching boats.
